Introduction

ShiOn is a South Korean singer under MODHAUS. She is a member of the girl group tripleS and its sub-units NXT, Hatchi!, Alphie, and Moon.

ShiOn was introduced as the twentieth member of the girl group tripleS on December 24, 2023. She first released the single "Just Do It" as part of the sub-unit NXT, before officially debuting with tripleS on May 8, 2024, with the album "ASSEMBLE24".
